portola.note: Goldenvoice's Portola (Pier 80, San Francisco) last ran Sept 26-27, 2026. No 2027 dates announced as of this date.

pretty lights.note: Pretty Lights is an artist, not a single festival. Requester was in Oakland; the nearby events are Fox Theater Oakland concerts (Nov 19-21, 2026), which are not festivals. Yahn Dawn (Buena Vista, CO) ran Sept 18-20, 2026 and has no announced 2027 edition. A Pretty Lights NYE run is listed Dec 31, 2026 - Jan 2, 2027 in Denver; not added because intent is unclear. Could be added if more people ask.
